Implemented: the product page now renders the title immediately and streams inventory/price afterward.

Changes in [app/product/page.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/product/page.tsx):
- Made `ProductPage` synchronous so it can render `<h1>` right away.
- Moved slow inventory fetch into async `InventoryDetails()`.
- Wrapped `InventoryDetails` in `Suspense` with an inline fallback so users see content during load.

Key refs:
- [ProductPage shell + Suspense](/vercel/sandbox/app/product/page.tsx#L4)
- [Deferred inventory fetch](/vercel/sandbox/app/product/page.tsx#L15)
- [Immediate fallback UI](/vercel/sandbox/app/product/page.tsx#L26)

Validation:
- `npm run build` passes.
- `/product` is now reported as partial prerender with streamed dynamic content, which matches the intended behavior.

Note: the repo already has other dirty/generated changes (`package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `.next/`, etc.) outside this fix.
